execution: pytest contract suite; deterministic, no paid model or business API

cases.acceptance: Actual file observation is used in a correction and the stored report passes its contract
A claim of success without required report content cannot complete the task
Encrypted snapshots equal actual HTTP bodies for every dispatched attempt
Updated or revoked sources invalidate old citations, including after restart
A completed child survives loss of parent publication without repeating model or tool work
A real parent exits without running cleanup; another process takes over expired leases and delivers the child result without redispatch
Repeated cancellation during failed extension activation cannot abandon owned resource cleanup
Concurrent controllers cannot overallocate the parent budget
Actual transport reconnect restores new calls without resubmitting the failed call
Preflight preserves task facts and tool pairs or rejects before model dispatch
A Chinese equivalent ranks above unrelated text for an English query using real neural weights
Actual container is non-root, lacks external network, cannot mutate input and is removed after timeout

limits: These contracts verify runtime controls. They do not measure real-model planning quality or production business correctness.
